criteria.description: Every acceptance criterion of the task, in order, with your verdict.

text.description: The criterion, as written in the task.

met.description: true only if the change meets it, with evidence.

evidence.description: One or two lines: the test, file:line, command output or reason behind the verdict.

findings.description: Problems in the change, most severe first; empty when there are none.

severity.description: high: CRITICAL, medium: WARNING, low: INFO.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root; empty if none.

line.description: Line in the file, or null.

message.description: What is wrong, why it matters and the fix.
